(2) Add an axios response interceptor for 401 on /api/frontend/* that surfaces a kiosk-toast `Session expirée — touchez l'écran pour redémarrer` AND triggers a graceful re-auth flow. (3) Add a Playwright assertion: after `goto('/kiosk/categories?cat=315')` the network capture must contain 0 401 on /api/frontend/menu.
